description: Compare baseline and candidate confirmed person facts across the same 1-19 explicit products. Both catalogs use one pinned immutable eligibility graph snapshot; rate rows retain independent evidence and as_of. Returns access, membership-path, and like-for-like published-price basis-point deltas: APY for deposits, APR for lending when both sides publish APR, otherwise nominal rate only when both sides publish nominal rate. It never mixes APR and nominal rate. Never describe missing access as denial or infer savings, underwriting, approval, or final terms.

name: compare_personal_access_catalogs

outputSchema.description: Two full access catalogs and evidence-linked changes under one immutable eligibility snapshot.

deltas.description: Per-product and portfolio reachability, membership-path, and published-price deltas. Per-product and portfolio reachable_now_counts contain exact baseline, candidate, and net product-offer-row counts; identity churn remains returned-detail scoped.

portfolio.description: Portfolio totals, including exact reachable_now_counts in product-offer rows.

products.description: Selector-aligned exact count and cap-scoped identity deltas.

best_published_price.description: Like-for-like APY, APR, or nominal-rate comparison. APR and nominal rate are never mixed; prices and delta are null when neither measure exists on both sides.

reachable_now_counts.description: Exact baseline, candidate, and net reachable-now product-offer row counts.

disclosure.description: No savings, underwriting, approval, denial, or final-terms claim.

semantics.description: Positive-evidence-only interpretation; absence is not denial.

snapshot.description: Pinned eligibility rules time and immutable graph generation; rates retain independent row as_of.
